generation.scope: For every reduced finite window with a generally invertible opposite root the cofactor defects equal the first cohomology of the pure exterior-square cokernel, and its Euler characteristic determines the residual length. A positive-dimensional rank-two scheme cannot be both generically reduced and supported on a smooth curve, even for disconnected or cubically special curves. Nonspecial smooth components of additive arithmetic genus are also excluded.

open_mathematics: Analyze the normalizations, conductor corrections and Pluecker derivatives of singular reduced rank-two curves, as well as generically multiple components and exceptional all-degree extension.
